d:
What does the BD team get up to in their downtime?
Shoots aren’t just about the locations we film - it’s also about the moments in between. In the South of France, we found ourselves hiking until sunset, diving into the sea at sunrise, and just enjoying the downtime together. These are the little memories that stick long after the cameras stop rolling.
South of France with the BD crew.
Sunrise swims.
Evening hikes.
Endless laughs.
Credits
